title: Fix Leaderboard date selector regression (availability days not showing)

requirements.text: Fix the backend query used to populate the Leaderboard “Select a date to record results” dropdown so it returns all availability days for the caller (including future dates), not a limited/past-only subset.

quotes: there were no dates to even select on the leaderboard tab in the section that says "select a date to record results"

acceptanceCriteria: A new or updated backend query returns every day (day ID) for which the caller has an availability entry.
Returned days include future dates if the caller has availability for them.
The query does not cap results to 5 days (no artificial limit for the Leaderboard use-case).

requirements.text: Update the frontend Leaderboard page to use the corrected “caller available days” data source so the date dropdown shows selectable dates whenever the user has added availability on the Calendar page.

quotes: im unable to select a date in the leaderboard tab to record results. Im getting the following message even though i already added an availability on the calendar page. "You must add availability on the Calendar page before you can record wins or losses."
there were no dates to even select on the leaderboard tab in the section that says "select a date to record results"

acceptanceCriteria: When the caller has at least one availability saved, the Leaderboard dropdown renders at least one SelectItem (no empty list).
The warning text “You must add availability on the Calendar page before you can record wins or losses.” is shown only when the caller truly has zero availability days.
Selecting any available day enables the Win/Loss +/- buttons and calls the existing record/remove mutations with that selected day.

requirements.text: Correct any backend sorting/logic issues in the existing getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs implementation so it behaves deterministically and does not contain comparator bugs (even if it remains used for match history).

quotes: This was working correctly prior to the latest update

acceptanceCriteria: The availability sorting comparator in getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs correctly references both compared elements (no self-references when reading dayB).
The function produces stable, predictable ordering for its returned results.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
Do not change leaderboard scoring, rank calculation, or win/loss recording rules beyond fixing the availability-day selection regression.
Do not implement real-time updates (no websockets).
